# Fab outputs, rev 0.2 (generated by scripts/gen_fab.py)

Changes from rev 0.1: MENU and BOOT labels by the buttons; R15 (white LED) 3.3 kOhm instead of 100 Ohm; the OLED header J3 and its I2C traces removed (the dock covers that area); "2068 PicoCart rev 0.2" on the underside. Build the firmware for these boards with -DLED2_PERCENT=100 (the default suits R15 = 100 Ohm).

- `jlcpcb/picocart-gerbers.zip`: 4-layer Gerbers (F, In1 = GND, In2 = +3V3, B; paste, silk, mask, edge) and Excellon drill + map.
- `jlcpcb/picocart-bom.csv`, `jlcpcb/picocart-cpl.csv`: JLCPCB assembly BOM and placement (top side; all mm, KiCad rotations).
- Not in the BOM/CPL (not assembled): J1 (dock edge fingers), TP1-TP7 (test pads), FID1, FID2, FID3.
- BOM lines with no LCSC number (pick at upload): none.
- L1 (Abracon AOTA-B201610S3R3-101-T, the RP2350 core-regulator inductor) is polarised. The footprint copies LCSC's land pattern and pad numbering, so no rotation offset should be needed, but check the preview: the dot on L1 must be on pad 2 (net DVDD, marked by the silkscreen dot), the end toward the dock fingers. Check its stock at upload: it ran out on 2026-10-12. If it is out again, remove it from the BOM and CPL and fit it by hand.
- DNP (footprint only, fitted by hand): R10 (0 R, dock BE to GPIO33).
- All drills are 0.3 mm or larger; all vias 0.6/0.3 mm.
- Check rotations in JLCPCB's placement preview: JLC's part orientation differs from KiCad's for many footprints (QFN, SOT-223, SOIC, connectors); fix there, not here.
- Upload order: PCB first (4 layers, 1.6 mm, ENIG or hard gold for the dock fingers, 30-45 degree finger bevel), then assembly with the BOM and CPL.
